Class InMemoryRepository<ID, E extends Entity<ID>>

java.lang.Object
repository.memory.InMemoryRepository<ID,E>
Type Parameters:
ID - the identifier type
E - the entity type
All Implemented Interfaces:
Repository<ID,E>
Direct Known Subclasses:
AbstractFileRepository
public class InMemoryRepository<ID, E extends Entity<ID>> extends Object implements Repository<ID,E>
Generic repository that stores validated entities in memory.
